Setting: the outer edge of the Niagara Falls Prospect Point Observation Tower deck in New York, high beside the massive cascading waterfall with billowing white mist and churning turquoise water far below.

Camera rule: the camera stays on the observation deck at chest height for the entire video. It never flies or moves down. It only pans and tilts.

00:00-00:01.5: A young American woman with damp blonde hair in a high messy bun, wearing a bright lime-green athletic sports bra and charcoal-gray athletic shorts, barefoot, stands on the outer edge of the deck. Two friends in clear rain ponchos watch, one covering her mouth in shock.
00:01.5-00:02.5: She leaps off the observation deck edge into the misty air beside the falls.
00:02.5-00:05: The camera tilts straight down along the tower structure next to the thundering cascade. She shrinks to a tiny dot. Far below, on a wet wooden platform near the base of the waterfall, sits a very small bright-orange rubber trampoline. She lands exactly in its center.
00:05-00:07.5: She launches straight back up, spinning in continuous tight backflips through the sunlit mist, growing larger as she rises. The camera tilts back up with her.
00:07.5-00:10: She lands cleanly on her feet at the exact same spot on the deck edge. Her friends scream with joy, throw their hands up, and wrap her in a tight celebratory hug.

One single woman with the same face, hair, and outfit throughout. Natural human anatomy, no extra limbs, no morphing, no camera cuts.

SEEDANCE 2.5 — DADDY, WHAT DO YOU DO IN THE BEDROOM? 😂

Create an exactly 30-second ultra-realistic vertical 9:16 family comedy video, recorded like a spontaneous iPhone 18 Pro Max home video.

1. SCENE & ENVIRONMENT

A cozy, modern American-style family bedroom with a large comfortable bed, beige bedsheets, soft pillows, neutral-colored walls and warm natural daylight coming through the bedroom window.

Daddy has just returned home from work. He is lying comfortably on his back on the bed, resting his head against two pillows. He looks relaxed and slightly tired.

His adorable toddler boy approaches the side of the bed and starts asking him funny questions.

The atmosphere should feel like a real, spontaneous family moment recorded at home.

2. CHARACTER DETAILS

BABY BOY:

- Adorable 18-month-old toddler.
- Wearing a blue full-sleeve sweatshirt and matching blue trousers.
- Cute short light-brown hair and expressive eyes.
- Standing beside Daddy's bed throughout the conversation.
- Uses tiny hand gestures and natural toddler expressions.
- Speaks with a cute, slightly imperfect toddler voice.

DADDY:

- Young father wearing a plain blue T-shirt.
- Lying on his back on the bed with his head supported by pillows.
- His upper body and face remain clearly visible.
- Reacts naturally to every question without getting out of bed.

MOMMY:

- Briefly visible in the bedroom doorway or background.
- Silently observes the conversation.
- Never speaks.

3. EXACT 30-SECOND TIMELINE & DIALOGUE

0:00–0:04 — BABY STARTS THE CONVERSATION

The camera is already positioned beside the bed, focusing on Daddy lying comfortably on his pillow.

The toddler walks into the frame beside the bed, looks directly at Daddy and asks:

Baby: "Daddy, can I ask you something?"

Daddy turns his head toward the baby and replies:

Daddy: "Sure, buddy!"

0:04–0:10 — THE FIRST QUESTION

The baby stands beside Daddy, slightly leaning toward him.

Baby: "What do you do in the bedroom after work?"

Daddy gives a relaxed smile while keeping his head on the pillow.

Daddy: "I just relax, sweetheart!"

0:10–0:16 — THE SECOND QUESTION

The baby tilts his head and asks with a curious expression:

Baby: "Then why does Mommy always say you're doing nothing?"

Daddy looks slightly confused and answers:

Daddy: "Because I'm resting!"

0:16–0:23 — THE UNEXPECTED QUESTION

The baby pauses briefly, looks straight into Daddy's eyes and asks:

Baby: "Then why does Mommy help you?"

Daddy's relaxed expression immediately changes.

He raises his eyebrows, opens his eyes wider and stares at the baby in surprise.

0:23–0:27 — DADDY'S REACTION

Daddy lifts his head slightly from the pillow and responds:

Daddy: "WHAT?!"

He looks completely caught off guard.

0:27–0:30 — FINAL PUNCHLINE

The baby maintains his innocent, serious expression and says:

Baby: "I think you need a new job, Daddy!"

Daddy immediately bursts into genuine laughter while still lying on the bed.

Mommy silently laughs in the background.

The baby looks at Daddy with a confused little expression.

4. CAMERA & FRAMING — VERY IMPORTANT

Daddy must remain the main camera subject for the entire 30-second video.

- Camera positioned beside the bed, slightly above Daddy's eye level.
- Keep Daddy's face, shoulders and upper body in the main frame.
- Daddy remains lying on his back throughout the entire scene.
- Baby stands beside the bed, visible near Daddy in the same frame whenever possible.
- Keep the camera focused primarily on Daddy's face and facial reactions.
- Do not switch to a baby-only close-up.
- Do not move the camera around the room.
- No separate reaction shots.
- No camera cuts or angle changes.
- Natural handheld smartphone micro-movements.
- Realistic autofocus and exposure adjustments.
- Authentic iPhone 18 Pro Max home-video appearance.

5. EXPRESSIONS & BODY LANGUAGE

Baby:

- Serious expression while asking questions.
- Small natural head tilts.
- Occasional tiny hand gestures.
- Innocent eye contact with Daddy.
- Slightly confused expression when Daddy starts laughing.
